risks.risk: Raw material price volatility, mainly cotton

risks.note: The technical textile industry, including the Company, continues to depend significantly on imports for speciality fibres, high-performance yarns and other advanced raw materials, and on foreign high-tech machinery.

The majority of the Company's business is export-oriented and depends on the global supply chain; the Middle East conflict, container shipping cost increases, availability and delays pose severe challenges, compounded by inefficient logistics in India.

Persistent geopolitical tensions (Russia-Ukraine conflict, US-Iran conflict), volatility in crude oil prices, inflationary pressures and a possible recession in the US and Europe could compress demand in domestic and export markets.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Cotton is the biggest cost component and is agricultural produce subject to climatic and seasonal volatility; other input costs (power, fuel, logistics) are also rising.
- The technical textile industry, including the Company, continues to depend significantly on imports for speciality fibres, high-performance yarns and other advanced raw materials, and on foreign high-tech machinery.
- The majority of the Company's business is export-oriented and depends on the global supply chain; the Middle East conflict, container shipping cost increases, availability and delays pose severe challenges, compounded by inefficient logistics in India.
- Persistent geopolitical tensions (Russia-Ukraine conflict, US-Iran conflict), volatility in crude oil prices, inflationary pressures and a possible recession in the US and Europe could compress demand in domestic and export markets.
- Management notes the industry is always subject to facing crisis in a cyclical way, requiring timely corrective and proactive steps.
- The Company is susceptible to pandemics, cyclones, earthquakes, geopolitical instability and fire hazards, which may cause operational disruption, shutdowns, production cuts, project delays, supply-chain hurdles and increased costs.
- Compliance issues with environmental norms and regulations, and supply chain challenges, continue to be issues of concern for the Company.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continued efforts across production, marketing, finance and cost control to sustain and improve operational performance.
- Continued focus on adopting sustainable business processes and infrastructure upgradation to maximise customer satisfaction and business relations.

- Strengthening resilience through product innovation, diversification and operational efficiency amid global market volatility.
